title: Website launch · Weekly check-in
summary:
The team will launch the new website on Friday. The homepage is ready; the remaining work is a pricing review, a final mobile check, and a short customer announcement.

### Decisions
- Keep the first release focused on the core product.
- Publish after the mobile review is complete.
- Review early feedback together on Monday.
transcript:

Alex: Great. I’ll prepare a short customer announcement. We’ll review early feedback on Monday.
